text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!!

Jungle Pocket came sprinting from the edge
of the school building with incredible momentum!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean "what's wrong"?!
I-I-It actually showed up!!
choice_data_list: Calm down! What do you mean 'it appeared'?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!?
Like it's not totally obvious—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It's a ghost!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There was nobody there, but I heard a voice!
Outta nowhere, it went, "Pokke-san"!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... My turf...
Guess I got no choice but to find somewhere else...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...No, at times like this, only they can...!

I brought Manhattan Cafe along to Jungle Pocket's hangout while nobody was around.
At first glance, nothing seemed out of the ordinary, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Partner! Don't look at me with that suspicious face!
Seriously, just a moment ago—"

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Ghost
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome back, Pokke-san!
Are those guys your new lackeys?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ooh?!
S-See?! You heard that, right?!
choice_data_list: Yeah... There's someone else here besides us...
Yeah... There's "someone" else here besides us...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So please!
Kick them off our turf!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey...
Why'd you get quiet all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Did you already chase it away?!
Did it already go somewhere else?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...
I was just thinking what a huge crowd it is...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The hell did you saaaay!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're not by yourself?! 
Hey, hold on! HEY!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
So many people have been captivated by Pokke-san...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Ghosts
text_block_list.text: ““““Pocket-san, 'suuuup!!””””

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!? There's so many of them!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...True to your title of 'Head'... As always, brilliant work..."
choice_data_list: Huh, an everyday occurrence? Does this happen often?
Huh, an everyday occurrence? Does this happen often?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... For example... having a line form outside the school gate...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! You mean like when guys ambush
me after class wanting to be my lackeys?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"B-Back then... until Cafe showed up,
I was in total despair thinkin' I'd never make it home for the rest of my life..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Cafe, I'm counting on you this time too...
I'm begging you...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand...
Then...—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—...Everyone has gone home...
They said they were glad
they got to hang out at Pokke-san's spot...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...!
You saved my skin, Cafe~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm already quite used
to requests from Pokke-san, so...
choice_data_list: They've really been patient in keeping up with me.
They've really been patient in keeping up with you, haven't they?
To think we'd end up relying entirely on Pocket...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm already quite used
to requests from Pokke-san, so...
choice_data_list: They've really been patient in keeping up with me.
They've really been patient in keeping up with you, haven't they?
To think we'd end up relying entirely on Pocket...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, thanks a lot! If you're ever in trouble,
just call me. I'll come running right away.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
if we're talking about recent troubles...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what's all this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "The residents of the old science prep room said they'd like to see Pokke-san run—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No, make it something I can actually do!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, keep this between us.
You too, Cafe, got it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
If you could invite me secretly again next time...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, keep 'em coming next time too—
Wait, huh!? Next time...!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Give me a break alreadyyy!!
